steps.title: Daily Site Report
steps.ask: I want to fill today's daily site report.
fill: Start a daily report for Dixie Road and Mayfield Road, on the Dixie corridor site. Day shift, Gurpreet Sandhu supervising.
On the storm sewer we had one foreman, four open-cut labourers and two pipelayers, ten hours each.
We ran the 40 tonne excavator and three tri-axle dump trucks, ten hours each.
We placed three hundred tonnes of Granular A under item C-15 a.
We lost two hours waiting for Bell to locate a duct bank at station fourteen plus two-eighty.
